caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt pattern composed of a grid of eight-pointed star shapes arranged diagonally. Each star is made up of red, brown, yellow, and blue sections, with the red segments containing white floral motifs, the brown segments containing lighter brown floral designs, and the blue segments featuring yellow patterns. The spaces between the stars are filled with a crosshatch pattern on a tan or cream-colored background. Along the left and bottom edges of the quilt, there is a white feathered vine border that curves in an arc, and each feather is shaded with grey lines for depth. The outermost edge is framed by a yellow and blue triangular zigzag design. The overall color palette includes red, tan, brown, white, blue, yellow, and grey. The quilt design is set against a plain beige background, with a faint pencil sketch marking dimensions in the lower left corner outside the main design.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
